stronger than [[mithril arrows]], and can be used by any standard [[bow]] of [[Maple bow|maple]] or stronger. They can be made at level 60 [[Fletching]] by using 15 [[adamant arrowtips]] on 15 [[headless arrow]]s, granting 150 Fletching [[experience]]. As with most [[Arrow|arrows]], they can be [[Poison#Weapon poisoning|poisoned]]. They are the best arrows available to [[free-to-play]] players. Adamant arrows can be purchased from [[Lowe's Archery Emporium]] in [[Varrock]], or [[Brian's Archery Supplies]] in [[Rimmington]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |version1 = Unpoisoned |version2
